name: El Camino Health Junior Auxiliary
city: Mountain View and Los Gatos, CA
what_you_do: A year-long hospital volunteer program for teens in Mountain View and Los Gatos.
who_can_apply: Age 14 or older and done with 8th grade. One-year minimum. Competitive, with limited spots. No summer-only option.
pay_detail: Unpaid volunteer program; no cost stated on the page
deadline_text: No application deadline posted. The page says to check back in mid-January 2027 for signup for the next Junior Application Seminar.
how_to_apply: Attend the annual application seminar, then apply. Info on the El Camino Health junior volunteer page.
notes: Hospital does not offer summer-only or programs shorter than one year. Locations are Mountain View and Los Gatos. Spots are limited (earlier check).
